checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: M1 storage core (atomic writes, sqlite catalog, hash-verified ingest); M2 HTTP API (token auth, upload, has, sync-state, status); M3 gallery UI + optional Pillow thumbnails; M4 Shortcut setup page + backup command; M5 README, CLI, end-to-end run

impact_assessment.why: User wants an iPhone to copy photos to their PC over home Wi-Fi with no app, and to delete from the phone only what the PC verifiably holds
impact_assessment.benefits: No iPhone app; originals kept; deletion gated on a server-side hash re-check; stdlib-only core
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Shortcuts may hash/send different bytes than expected; dependency: Pillow/pillow-heif optional; concurrency: parallel uploads of same file; state: sqlite catalog and partial uploads on power loss
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reject any hash mismatch so nothing unverified is deletable; Pillow imported only in thumbnail adapter; sqlite transactions with unique sha256; uploads stream to .incoming temp, fsync, then os.replace

checkpoints.description: [5/5] M1-M5 built: hash-verified store, Shortcut API, gallery, setup guide, backup, README, ADR-001; 45 tests and 4/4 gates pass; live server smoke run passed; checklists: passed; not committed (host requires an explicit commit request)

[1/5] Plan: M1 profiles data (catalog v2 migration, ProfileBook, per-profile journal, owner-key compat); M2 profile-aware auth/API + disk importer + CLI import; M3 ServerRunner + tkinter control panel (start/stop, profiles, import folder), Harbor.pyw, Open Photo Browser.url; M4 gallery: people filter, setup per profile, folder upload; M5 tests, Playwright review, README, ADR-004/005, gates

impact_assessment.why: User asked for a server start button, a photo browser file, per-person profiles and import from disk
impact_assessment.benefits: No command line needed; each phone syncs into its own profile; existing photo folders can be brought in
impact_assessment.risks: contract: library key now also means the main profile, catalog format 1 -> 2; dependency: tkinter (stdlib, may be absent on some installs); concurrency: CLI import alongside a running server writes the same SQLite file; state: in-place schema migration of an existing catalog
impact_assessment.mitigation: Migration is additive (ALTER ADD COLUMN, new table) in one transaction with .bak copy first; old Shortcut keys keep working as main; WAL + per-row unique sha handles two writers, duplicate placement detected and rolled back; panel degrades to an error message without tkinter

checkpoints.description: [5/5] Profiles (catalog v2, per-person keys/sync), disk import (window, CLI, browser folder), ServerRunner + Harbor window, Harbor.pyw, Open Photo Browser.url; fixes: keep-alive traceback spam, stop-during-import; 74 tests, 4/4 gates, Edge + Tk screenshots, pythonw launch verified; ADR-004/005; checklists: passed; uncommitted pending user request

[3/3] Start with Windows (Run key, window + web switch, --startup minimised + immediate server, real registry round-trip verified and removed); GB scale: catalog v3 import skip-list + totals index, NOT INDEXED name search, 4 MB I/O, preview warmer + JPEG draft, 3 parallel browser uploads; measured: re-import 11s->0.0s, people 223->10ms, search 344->14ms, import 66->97MB/s; 82 tests, 4/4 gates; ADR-006; checklists: passed; uncommitted pending user request

[1/6] Plan: M1 catalog v4 (copies per person, profile folder, password hash, sessions) + store writes readable paths <Person>/<YYYY>/<YYYY-MM>/ with hard-linked shared photos; M2 resumable reorganiser moving existing files + library README.txt + hidden .harbor + folder rename; M3 accounts: PBKDF2 passwords, sessions, name+password login (key fallback), change/reset password, login rate limit, per-person privacy on every endpoint; M4 UI: login picker, My account, owner resets, window Open folder + set password, disk-space warning; M5 weekly integrity check; M6 tests, docs, ADR-007/008, review, screenshots

impact_assessment.why: User asked that each person reach their own photos, change their passwords, and find photos in plain, understandable Windows folders usable without Harbor; plus proposals 1 and 3
impact_assessment.benefits: Private per-person galleries, password sign-in, photos browsable in File Explorer, early warning before the disk fills or a file rots
impact_assessment.risks: contract: login moves from keys to name+password, non-owners lose the everyone view, on-disk layout changes; dependency: none new (hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac, os.link); concurrency: reorganiser moving files while uploads arrive; state: catalog v3->v4 migration and moving every original
impact_assessment.mitigation: Key sign-in kept as fallback; migration additive with backup copy; file moves are per-file, resumable, verified by size, done under the store's placement lock; hard link falls back to copy

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Done: catalog v4 (copies, folders, passwords, sessions); readable <Person>/<YYYY>/<YYYY-MM> layout with hard links, bilingual guide, hidden .harbor, legacy move verified on 60 real files; Explorer reconcile with unplugged-drive guard; weekly file check; PBKDF2 sign-in, sessions, brake, change/reset password, per-person privacy; window: More menu (password, rename, open folder), library folder, check files, free space; gallery: name picker login, account menu, My account, owner tools, disk banner; 95 tests, 4/4 gates, Edge+Tk screenshots; ADR-007/008; checklists: passed; uncommitted pending user request
